comments.author: @SusanLowe-o7x
comments.text:
I been going to India for almost 30 years now. So yes, I am that old...For all of those years I have wanted, dreamt, hoped that before I die I wanted to spend the summer in Kashmir. The friends that I met in the first time I met in 99, I still have today. All my Kashmiri friends have always told me that it is the most beautiful place in the world. With videos show me that it is very true.
Regrettably I am now 70 years old, and my breathing would suffer because of the altitude it looks like I shall never get to see this most beautiful of places. But my heart tells me that no matter what my heart belongs to Kashmir, and though I may never get there I still belong there. I don't know why or how I have felt like this, but I can honestly say I have wanted to be there for so long.
Thank you for this video it helps me to see what my heart knows.❤❤❤😊😊😊

replies.text: Thank you for sharing something this personal - even if the altitude keeps you from standing there yourself, it sounds like Kashmir has had a piece of your heart for a very long time already. Glad the film could bring a little of it closer.
